svg.title: Customer lifetime value built by retention flows
svg.desc: Over 12 months one customer places six orders, each triggered by a retention flow such as a refill reminder or loyalty points. Lifetime value climbs from 649 to 4,294 rupees and the LTV to CAC ratio rises from 0.7x to 4.8x.
svg.text: Each repeat order comes from a planned retention flow
Above 3x, you can scale ads profitably
